entries.what: Labor Day: college is closed and Linh sleeps in, then does her Sunday-style planner reset at the Pell Road house with lo-fi on. Color-codes the week's anatomy reading in pink and blue.
entries.outcome: Week planned with washi tape and times for every block.

entries.what: Afternoon at Heron & Grind is not on her schedule, but Jun texts that Paolo bailed on early lumpia prep again. She sympathizes and offers to look at his numbers later.
entries.outcome: Agrees to help Jun with numbers sometime this week.

entries.what: Evening at Delgado Park with Hạnh and neighbors for a quiet Labor Day picnic; Hạnh mentions pharmacy once and Linh nods and changes topic.
entries.outcome: Got through dinner without the pharmacy talk.

entries.what: Morning bike ride to Tamsen Valley College for the first Tuesday of General Chemistry at 11. The syllabus lists the midterm on Oct 20 at 8 a.m., which she writes in yellow in her planner.
entries.outcome: Midterm date logged in the planner.

entries.what: Skips Pedro's Tuesday 4 p.m. anatomy group and studies alone with her 600-card deck at a library corner. Forgets to eat lunch until 3.
entries.outcome: Finished a chapter of flashcards, ate a granola bar late.

entries.what: Home for dinner with Hạnh and a plate of leftovers, then bed around 12:30 after planner review.
Anatomy & Physiology at 9 with Dr. Okoye; Linh sits beside Rochelle and takes pink muscle notes. Hears classmates talk about the practical and starts calling it that in her head.
entries.outcome: Good notes on the muscular system.

entries.what: Works Heron & Grind noon to 6 pulling shots. Wes orders his cortado and Jun coaches her on heart pours between customers.
entries.outcome: Pours a decent heart on the third try.

entries.what: Rides home in the fog, eats the plate Hạnh left, and texts Thao good luck on her night shift.
Chemistry at 11 on campus; Kenji gives her a ride home after since it is Thursday.
entries.outcome: Ride and a bit of gossip about Bayshore transfers.

entries.what: Sam asks Linh to cover a third Saturday swap. She asks the assistant to help word a decline, then rewrites the text to say 'maybe' instead of no.
Evening study session at home with the lo-fi playlist, working through the skeletal system in blue.
Anatomy at 9, then a lab walkthrough of the bones; Rochelle asks the questions Linh is too shy to ask.
Friday off work; she helps Hạnh at the house and sees neighbors heading to the Egrets home football opener.
entries.outcome: Stays in and reviews flashcards instead of going.

entries.what: Late night, Thao texts her to eat something before bed; Linh answers with a thumbs-up.
Saturday 6:30 opening shift at Heron & Grind. Beatrice's new deal starts: Jun sells lumpia at the counter on Saturdays for a 15% cut, and the first tray sells out by 10.
entries.outcome: Lumpia debut goes well; Linh runs the register for it.

entries.what: Wraps the shift at 1, grabs a rice bowl, and takes a nap before planner time.
Evening video call with Kenji about his transfer paperwork and a quiet vent about the pharmacy question.
Sunday 6:30 to 1 shift at Heron & Grind; Wes jokes about her flashcards between orders.
Front desk at Lotus Nails from 2 to 5 with Hạnh, who brags about Linh's latte art to a customer.
Walks the Ulloa marsh boardwalk, then does the Sunday-night planner with washi tape for week 3.
